proposed_widenings.name: area shape: cone
proposed_widenings.justification: Color Spray targets a 15-foot Cone originating from the caster. The Attachment area shape union currently only has { kind: 'sphere'; radiusFeet: number }. A cone shape requires { kind: 'cone'; lengthFeet: number } (origin is always the caster, so no AreaOrigin needed for self-originating cones, or it could reuse the existing AreaOrigin grammar).
proposed_widenings.evidence: Each creature in a 15-foot Cone originating from you must succeed on a Constitution saving throw

proposed_widenings.name: Effect variant: apply_condition
proposed_widenings.justification: The save_gate ActivationPhase takes onFail/onSuccess of type Effect, which is DamageEffect | NoneEffect. Color Spray's on-fail result is applying the Blinded condition — not damage. The apply_condition atom exists in v4 taxonomy and already appears in SaveGateRiderResult (mastery surface), but is absent from the spell Effect union.
proposed_widenings.evidence: must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or have the Blinded condition until the end of your next turn

proposed_widenings.name: Condition: 'blinded'
proposed_widenings.justification: The Condition type is currently only 'prone'. Color Spray inflicts 'blinded'. This type must be widened to include 'blinded' before apply_condition can be used in spell effects.
proposed_widenings.evidence: have the Blinded condition until the end of your next turn

notes: The spell structure maps cleanly to activation + save_gate once the three surface gaps are filled. The timed expiry ('until the end of your next turn') would also need a condition-duration shape in the apply_condition effect (e.g., { expiresOn: { kind: 'end_of_next_turn' } }), but this can be modeled as a rider expiry analogous to the mastery RiderExpiry type. All required v4 atoms (apply_condition, area, save_gate) already exist. No new atoms are needed.
